summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The USCF Oil Plus Bitcoin Strategy Fund (WTIB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks total return by providing exposure to the performance of the crude oil markets and Bitcoin (BTC). The fund invests in futures contracts and other pooled investment vehicles. WTIB was launched on Dec 9, 2025 and is issued by Marygold.
